label: GO step committing strongly to a2, mid-episode (mostly after a reward)
explanation: Fires only at GO, and essentially only when the agent picks a2 (action==2 / choice logit < -7 gives recall 1.0 but precision 0.35). It is never active at D1 or D2, or on a1 choices. Two further things gate it: (1) the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1 holds 84% of the mass), and (2) the episode is in its middle: almost no activity on trials 0-9 or 70-99, the most on 10-69. This looks like slow drift in the hidden state, not something the task defines. Magnitude is largest on the first rewarded a2 GO after an unrewarded trial and decays over a run of consecutive rewarded a2 trials. Precision stays incomplete because many a2 GOs after a reward stay silent. Uses only observed history plus the agent own current choice (ep_trial is elapsed time, not future). Without the ep_trial window F1 drops to about 0.58.
